title: Inventor workflows and connector status
description: Explore Inventor workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.
html:
SoftwareUpcoming

Autodesk

Inventor

Autodesk Inventor provides parametric mechanical modelling, assembly design and documentation workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Parameterise a machine component

Start from current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Inventor preview, parameterise a machine component; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Inspect assembly interference

Begin with the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Inventor preview, inspect assembly interference; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Generate production drawings

Use the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Inventor preview, generate production drawings; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
